issue: New entry does not persist across page reload
actual: Added entry 'QA Test Entry' appeared immediately in the table (6 entries), but after navigating/reloading the page, the app reset to its initial default state: only the original 5 entries remained and the new entry was gone. Additionally, the 'Urgent' field added earlier also disappeared. Checked localStorage/sessionStorage after reload - both are empty, confirming the app keeps no persisted state at all.

evidence: Added a new field 'Urgent' of type Checkbox via Fields dialog. It immediately appeared as a new column in table view and as a new attribute block in card view for all existing entries (shown as '—' for unset values), and also appeared in the Add Entry form with a checkbox control.

Added entry 'Alpha Test Entry' with text=Alpha Test Entry, number=7, date=2026-03-10 (Mar 10, 2026), checkbox=checked. Values saved and displayed identically in both Table view (row cells) and Card view (Priority: 7, Due Date: Mar 10, 2026, Completed: Yes).
Switched from Table to Cards view; all 6 entries and their field values (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed) remained unchanged and consistent between views.
Filled values (Alpha Test Entry) and empty values (Urgent field on pre-existing entries, shown as '—') both rendered consistently and identically between Table and Card views.

Fields configuration dropdown clearly labels type options as 'Text', 'Number', 'Date', 'Checkbox'. Add Entry form provides a textbox for text, a spinbutton for number, a date input for date, and a checkbox toggle (with Yes/No label) for checkbox fields.

Table view renders checked checkboxes as a green check icon (lucide-check, text-success class) and unchecked as a muted X icon (lucide-x, text-muted-foreground). Card view and entry form additionally show explicit 'Yes'/'No' text labels alongside icons.

Sorted Table view by Priority (asc then desc, verified order 1,1,2,2,3,7 then 7,3,2,2,1,1). Switched to Cards view: sort reset to none (original order), then set Cards to sort by Due Date ascending (verified order Jan14,15,18,20,25,Mar10). Switched back to Table view: Priority descending sort was still active and correctly ordered, confirming independent sort state per view.

Selecting 'Priority' from Sort menu immediately reordered entries ascending; toggling direction via column header reordered descending. Status text 'Sorted by Priority (ascending/descending)' clearly identified active field and direction. App remained fully usable (other controls responsive) throughout.

Before and after sorting by Priority (asc/desc) and Due Date, entry count remained 6 and all field values (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed) for each entry were unchanged - only row order changed.

With no field sort active, dragged (via keyboard-accessible drag handle) 'Alpha Test Entry' from last to first position in Table view - order became Alpha, Design, Review, Update, Prepare, Team sync. In Cards view (sort cleared), dragged 'Alpha Test Entry' to 2nd position - order became Design, Alpha, Review, Update, Prepare, Team sync. Switching back to Table view showed the table's own manual order (Alpha first) preserved, confirming independent manual order per view.

issue: No filtering feature is implemented/exposed in the UI
actual: Searched the entire visible UI (header controls: Fields, Sort, Table/Cards toggle, Add Entry, Search box) and inspected the full DOM/HTML for any element, button, icon, or attribute referencing 'filter'. No filter control exists anywhere - no per-field filter criteria UI, no filter panel, no filter button on column headers. Only Sort (which reorders but does not exclude entries) and quick Search (free-text) are available. There is no way to define field-specific filter criteria or view only matching entries.

issue: Filtering feature does not exist, so filter correctness cannot be verified
actual: As found under FT-6, there is no filter UI or mechanism in the application. Since filtering criteria cannot be defined, entries cannot be included/excluded per criteria, and there is nothing to 'clear' - the required behavior is entirely absent.

issue: No import feature is implemented/exposed in the UI
actual: Inspected the full UI (header, Fields configuration dialog, entry rows/cards, action buttons) and the DOM/HTML for any 'import' or 'export' related control. The Fields dialog only shows a note stating 'Configure fields before importing data' but provides no actual import button, file picker, or paste-data control anywhere in the app. There is no way to import data at all.

evidence: Priority field is a native HTML input[type=number]. Attempting to type non-numeric text ('abc') into it was rejected outright (Playwright: 'Cannot type text into input[type=number]'), demonstrating the control structurally prevents non-numeric entry. Valid numeric value 42 was accepted and saved correctly (entry 'Number Field Test' shows Priority=42 in the table).

Due Date field is a native HTML input[type=date]. Setting its value to an invalid calendar date ('2026-13-45', month 13/day 45) was rejected by the browser and the value reverted to empty string, confirming invalid dates cannot be entered. A valid date (2026-05-05) was accepted and saved correctly, displaying as 'May 5, 2026' in the table.

Typed lowercase 'review' in Search box; it matched 'Review marketing materials' (case-insensitive substring match), result count updated to '1 entry matching \"review\"'. Cleared the search via the clear (x) button; all 7 entries were restored and count returned to '7 entries'.

issue: Quick search matches only raw/internal field values, not the formatted values shown to users
actual: Searching for the displayed date text 'Jan 18' (as shown in both Table and Card views for 'Review marketing materials') returned 0 results ('0 entries matching \"Jan 18\"'). Searching instead for the raw internal ISO date '2026-01-18' correctly returned that entry. Similarly, searching for 'Yes' (the displayed Completed checkbox state shown for multiple entries) returned 0 results, even though 'Yes' is visibly displayed in the UI for those entries. This confirms search only matches raw/internal values, not the formatted/displayed values as required.
